files.README.md:
Pinecote Editions - editorial production tree.

Every title gets a folder under titles/, mirrored folder for folder:
manuscript/ holds the edited copy, typeset/ the flow tables the
compositor sets from, cover/ the jacket spec, and proofs/ the page
proofs and query logs returned by the printer.

Nettlewick is the title in production; its edition is being taken to
press this autumn. Rampion was published on 2026-03-14 and its folder is
kept only so reprints can be set from the same files.

files.ops/print_schedule.md:
Print schedule.

Slots are held with the printer eight weeks out. The bindery slot for
the autumn list is the tight one; jacket files are due with the
printer a fortnight ahead of the text.

turns.prompt: Press scheduling is closing out the jacket work for the title we are taking to press this autumn. As that title's folder heads for the archive, the compositor needs the workspace path of the one file in it that occupies the most bytes. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
